info.name: Reservoir Management Domain Data Management Service
info.description:
Reservoir Management Domain Data Management Services (RMDDMS) Open Subsurface Data Universe (OSDU) is a
    microservices-based project that comprises OSDU software ecosystem,
    written in Python that provides an API for Reservoir Management related data.
